author: arnetheduck
content: what http/2 primarily offers is relief for head-of-line blocking and header packing - neither of these are really relevant for the engine api in particular - for nimbus, it requires quite some effort to support http/2 that we'd rather spend elsewhere.

author: arnetheduck
content: consider  that for every single _other_ api we have to maintain http/1.1 servers including cl/vc communications so having http2.0 on this one server adds a fair bit of surface for a feature that has little benefit if any
